Use a font file with Text

Source: R/fonts.R
register_font.Rd

Makes the font in font_file available to Text(), MarkupText() and Paragraph() under its family name, which is returned. The file is looked up as given, then in assets/fonts/ and fonts/ below the working directory, as upstream does relative to the scene file.

Usage

register_font(font_file)

Arguments

font_file

Path to a font file (for example .ttf or .otf).

Value

The font family name, invisibly.

Details

Upstream's register_font() is a context manager that unregisters the font when the with block ends. Here the font stays registered for the rest of the R session (through systemfonts::register_font()), so Text("Hi", font = register_font("MyFont.ttf")) works directly.

The first file registered for a family is used for every style (regular, bold, italic, bold italic). A later file of the same family replaces only its own style, so registering a regular and a bold file gives weight = "BOLD" the bold one. A file whose family is already installed is usable by name, so its family is returned without registering it (systemfonts does not allow registering an installed family) and the installed faces are used.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Needs a font file of your own.
family <- register_font("fonts/MyFont-Regular.ttf")
Text("Hello", font = family)
} # }
